title: Connection diagnostics
intro: A read-only check verifies the saved endpoint. Image generation is a separate, optional test.
saveFirst: Save your changes before testing this provider.
requestFailed: Could not check this saved provider. Check its settings and try again.
completed: Test image saved in a separate connection-test conversation.
unknownOutcome: The test did not return a completed image. Its outcome may be unknown and a charge may still apply. Check your connection-test conversation and provider usage before trying again. No automatic retry was made.
cost: This sends one real image request and may incur a charge. Pricing is set by your provider. The result is saved in a separate connection-test conversation.
once: One request only. No automatic retry. If the outcome is unknown, check provider usage before testing again.

codes.invalid_config: Check the saved URL and API key
codes.connection_failed: Connection failed; check network, DNS and TLS
codes.head_only: Reachability only; this endpoint has no supported model check
codes.rate_limited: Rate limited; check provider quota before trying again
codes.model_endpoint_missing: Model endpoint unavailable; support is unverified
codes.unrecognized_response: Response did not verify the model
